pages.brief: Pip the sparrow looking out through an old barn window at grey rain falling outside.
Pip the sparrow hopping across straw-covered barn floorboards, picking up a short length of brown string.
Pip the sparrow dropping a small round button and a twist of golden straw into a little open tin.
Pip the sparrow arranging brown string, a button and golden straw carefully inside a little tin.
Pip the sparrow carefully tying straw and string into a tiny sailboat shape with a button as a wheel.
Pip the sparrow admiring his finished tiny straw sailboat on a barn windowsill while rain patters on the roof outside.
